verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אַל־ תַּשְׁחֵ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃ ה֘וֹדִ֤ינוּ לְּךָ֨׀ אֱ‍ֽלֹהִ֗ים ה֭וֹדִינוּ שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וְקָר֣וֹב סִ֝פְּר֗וּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ’al- taš·ḥêṯ miz·mō·wr lə·’ā·sāp̄ šîr hō·w·ḏî·nū lə·ḵā ’ĕlō·hîm hō·w·ḏî·nū šə·me·ḵā wə·qā·rō·wḇ sip·pə·rū nip̄·lə·’ō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster vvv [To the tune of] “Do Not Destroy A Psalm of Asaph A song We give thanks to You O God we give thanks for Your Name is near The people declare Your wondrous works

verses.original: כִּ֭י אֶקַּ֣ח מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲ֝נִ֗י אֶשְׁפֹּֽט׃ מֵישָׁרִ֥ים
verses.literal: When I choose a time I will judge fairly

verses.original: אֶ֥רֶץ וְכָל־ יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ נְֽמֹגִ֗ים אָנֹכִ֨י תִכַּ֖נְתִּי עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.literal: When the earth and all its dwellers quake it is I who bear up its pillars Selah

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַֽ֭הוֹלְלִים אַל־ תָּהֹ֑לּוּ וְ֝לָרְשָׁעִ֗ים אַל־ תָּרִ֥ימוּ קָֽרֶן׃
verses.literal: I say to the proud Do not boast and to the wicked Do not lift up your horn

verses.original: אַל־ תָּרִ֣ימוּ קַרְנְכֶ֑ם לַמָּר֣וֹם תְּדַבְּר֖וּ עָתָֽק׃ בְצַוָּ֣אר
verses.literal: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָרִֽים׃ לֹ֣א מִ֭מּוֹצָא וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב וְ֝לֹ֗א מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kî hā·rîm lō mim·mō·w·ṣā ū·mim·ma·‘ă·rāḇ wə·lō mim·miḏ·bar
verses.literal: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west nor out of the desert

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים שֹׁפֵ֑ט יַ֝שְׁפִּ֗יל זֶ֥ה יָרִֽים׃ וְזֶ֣ה
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm šō·p̄êṭ yaš·pîl zeh yā·rîm wə·zeh
verses.literal: but it is God who judges He brings down one and exalts another

verses.original: כִּ֤י כ֪וֹס בְּֽיַד־ יְהוָ֡ה מָ֥לֵא חָמַ֨ר׀ וְיַ֤יִן מֶסֶךְ֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ר מִ֫זֶּ֥ה אַךְ־ כֹּ֝֗ל רִשְׁעֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃ יִשְׁתּ֑וּ יִמְצ֣וּ שְׁ֭מָרֶיהָ
verses.transliteration: kî ḵō·ws bə·yaḏ- Yah·weh mā·lê ḥā·mar wə·ya·yin me·seḵ way·yag·gêr miz·zeh ’a·ḵōš- kōl riš·‘ê- ’ā·reṣ yiš·tū yim·ṣū šə·mā·rê·hā
verses.literal: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD full of foaming wine mixed with spices He pours from [His cup] and all the wicked of the earth drink it down . . . to the dregs

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי אַגִּ֣יד לְעֹלָ֑ם אֲ֝זַמְּרָ֗ה לֵאלֹהֵ֥י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.literal: But I will proclaim Him forever I will sing praise to the God of Jacob

verses.original: וְכָל־ קַרְנֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים אֲגַדֵּ֑עַ קַֽרְנ֥וֹת צַדִּֽיק׃ תְּ֝רוֹמַ֗מְנָה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl qar·nê rə·šā·‘îm ’ă·ḡad·dê·a‘ qar·nō·wṯ ṣad·dîq tə·rō·w·mam·nāh
verses.literal: All the horns of the wicked I will cut off but the horns of the righteous will be exalted
